## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
lib/zaq/channels/api.ex and new lib/zaq/channels/delivery_files.ex. Carry TrustedContext.from_event via existing bridge map; authorize with normalized context only. Shared with_prepared preparation normalizes valid Records, uses registered Materialization, preserves binary/declared encoding and filename/MIME, and scopes resources around consumer use. Prefer existing bytes; introduce owned paths only if needed.

## Tests to add before implementation
delivery_files_test.exs and API tests: exact non-UTF8 bytes, malformed/base64 content, metadata safety, missing/forged identity, source error, denied/revoked access, missing source, consumer error/exception and original file preservation. Property tests for exact-byte normalization. Conditional process-death cleanup test only if temp files introduced.

## Branches/paths validated
No files bypass preparation; supplied files materialize once. Pass actor but never connector credentials to source. Validate shape, not provider acceptance limits. Existing whole-content acquisition limitation remains #875.

## Mocking plan
Real materialization/domain routes; controlled external edges and supported per-call/event opts. No global env or fake production callbacks.

## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Keep affected module docs accurate. Coordinate the final docs/services/channels.md update and update this issue with evidence/decisions; follow documentation hygiene.

## Action reuse assessment
Reuse Materialization.materialize/4, handlers and NodeRouter. Local-only helper owns prepared resources, not source/provider dispatch or limits. Missing identity cannot elevate access; errors return through existing bridge contract.

## Constraints and validation
Read parent settled decisions and applicable repository service, tool-routing, Action reuse and testing policies before implementation. Preserve current test behavior. Follow authoritative validation lifecycle; feature E2E authoring waits for final review task, but focused tests are immediate. Agent selection and #875 acquisition budgets are outside scope. No global configuration mutation.

comments.text: Module-context / Action reuse evidence: Api is Channels event orchestration: deliver_outgoing resolves Bridge/config, formats Outgoing, invokes send_reply then DeliveryConfirmation; it owns neither provider transport nor source bytes. Record is a pure canonical struct; Outgoing attachments are explicit Record structs. Materialization.materialize/4 verifies signed handles through Registry then registered handlers and normalizes nested Records (whole-content acquisition remains #875). CommunicationMedia rechecks author or canonical Engine transcript authorization; DiskDocument routes to Storage; DataSourceDocument routes fixed Channels download events. TrustedContext.from_event is the envelope identity projection; normalize drops incoming/credentials/runtime fields. Source paths and credentials must never become prepared transport data. Existing API tests assert exact text-only connection maps, so attach trusted_context only on nonempty attachment deliveries; preserve text-only behavior without changing existing tests. DeliveryFiles will expose with_prepared(records, context, consumer, opts \\ []), project trusted identity and explicitly supported local router dependencies separately, materialize lazy inputs exactly once, decode only declared base64, preserve raw binary bytes, and pass only content/name/mime_type/size to the scoped consumer. No files or callbacks retained and no owned paths; consumer errors/exceptions propagate; original source files untouched. Source registry/action discovery: searched registry/tools and use Jido.Action/use Zaq.Engine.Workflows.Action declarations, workflow Steps, domain APIs and materialization consumers. Existing DownloadDocument Action delegates Materialization but is model/workflow input/output orchestration, not channel resource lifetime. Reuse Materialization/registered handlers/fixed role events; local-only preparation normalizes transport bytes and invokes a synchronous consumer, inappropriate as separately exposed Action because callback lifetime is local. General EncodeBase64/DecodeBase64 Actions are standalone transforms, not file validation or scoped resource ownership. No new Action or agent exposure. Current tests prove handlers/signatures/options/auth, API routing/formatting. New tests will prove preparation exact bytes/property, malformed content/metadata, once-only acquisition, denied/revoked/source errors, trusted actor projection, consumer return/exception and original disk file preservation. Unknown: adapter tuple shape settled in .3; helper returns neutral prepared maps. Serena initial/activation succeeded; first overview calls stalled for over a minute and were cancelled; bounded source fallback used.
